title: An embedded C¹ n-submanifold has n-dimensional density one at each of its points
statement: Let P, n ∈ ℕ, let M ⊆ ℝ^P satisfy IsEmbeddedSubmanifold 1 n M, and let z ∈ M. Then Hⁿ(M ∩ B_s(z))/(ω_n sⁿ) → 1 as s ↓ 0, computed in [0, ∞], where Hⁿ = μHE[n], B_s(z) is the open ball, and ω_n = unitBallVolume n is the Lebesgue measure of the unit ball of ℝ^n.
lean_statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (M : Set (Euclid P)) (z : Euclid P), IsEmbeddedSubmanifold 1 n M → z ∈ M → Tendsto (fun s : ℝ => μHE[n] (M ∩ ball z s) / (unitBallVolume n * ENNReal.ofReal (s ^ n))) (𝓝[>] 0) (𝓝 1)
